_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
bucks: The Bucks' season runs late October to April at Fiserv Forum, 41 home dates, with the play-in and the playoffs beyond that.
brewers: Spring training opens in Phoenix in February and the regular season in late March at American Family Field; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
admirals: The Admirals' AHL season runs October to April at the Panther Arena, 36 home dates, with the Calder Cup playoffs beyond that.
packers: The Packers' season runs September to January at Lambeau Field in Green Bay, with the playoffs beyond that; flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
marquette: Marquette's season runs November to March at Fiserv Forum, with the Big East tournament and the NCAA tournament beyond that; the schedule arrives in the autumn.
panthers: The Panthers' season runs November to March at the Panther Arena, with the Horizon League tournament beyond that; the schedule arrives in the autumn.
